title: Flow Node Definition v1 (ADR-010)
description: Portable, signable metadata describing a contributed flow node: display, typed ports, configuration schema, and a HANDLER REFERENCE that the server-authoritative compiler lowers to canonical core IR. Never runtime code. v1 accepts ONLY the 'core-preset' and 'service-action' handler kinds; the later kinds (connector-action, subflow, quickjs, hosted-action) are known-but-not-enabled and MUST be rejected with a distinct error. Port/configuration schemas use the declaration subset that is strictly TIGHTER than the desktop's §6.5 runtime validator: structural keywords type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/minLength/maxLength/minimum/maximum, annotations title/description/default/examples, $ref only from the local allowlist (formlogic://schemas/artifact-ref.json), and x-artifactKinds — anything else fails closed (see ADR-010 for the rationale). The operative cross-language gates are the TypeScript and PHP validators pinned by docs/contracts/fixtures/application-package-v2-cases.json; this schema documents the shape.

type.description: Namespaced contributed type, >=3 dot-segments (e.g. com.acme.media.generate-image). Core types are dot-free and cannot be shadowed. Inside an aggregate, must extend the owning package's publisherId.

iconId.description: Host icon allowlist id; an unknown id renders the default icon (presentation-only).

multiple.description: true → the port explicitly accepts a collection (fan-in); ambiguous multiple incoming values are otherwise rejected by the compiler.

schema.description: Declaration-subset JSON Schema for data ports (see the top-level description). Depth <=8, <=64 properties per object, <=64 enum entries, serialized <=32KiB.

configurationSchema.description: Declaration-subset JSON Schema (object type) for the node's stored data/config.

uiHints.description: Presentation-only control hints keyed by configuration property. Invalid entries are DROPPED, never fatal (the one ignorable surface).

handler.description: The host-owned execution mechanism this node lowers to. v1 allowlist: core-preset | service-action.

coreType.description: An existing dot-free core node type; the compiler validates it against the live catalog.

defaults.description: Validated defaults merged into the lowered core node's data. Serialized <=32KiB.

availability.description: A REQUEST only; effective availability is the intersection with the trusted handler's host support, the installed implementation, the bound device, and policy. Package metadata can narrow the host matrix but never expand it.

requiredGrants.description: Advisory declaration; effective permissions are ALWAYS derived transitively from the handler, referenced action, transport, and side effects — an empty list cannot suppress them.
